dataset: app.ml.synthetic held-out ('test') merchants, unseen by rules and the ML model
command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m app.ml.eval_llm --n 300 --provider gemini --model gemini-3.5-flash-lite
metrics_note: Accuracy counts abstentions as wrong. Macro-F1 and per-class metrics were not computed. The hybrid baseline uses min_confidence=0.0 (evaluation mode), not the production suggest-first policy.
protocol: Single holdout of synthetic 'test' merchants; not the 5-fold merchant-grouped CV in report.md.
caveats: Synthetic merchants: this measures interface correctness and relative accuracy, not real-statement accuracy.
The first-choice model (gemini-2.5-flash) is closed to new API keys; 3.8/3.5 Flash returned free-tier 503s, so Flash-Lite was used.
Free-tier quota is 20 generate requests per model per day; n=300 uses 12. A rerun on the same day may return 429.
Temperature 0.0, 25 items per request, structured JSON schema shared with the Anthropic adapter.
0 abstentions reflects the fixed LLM_CONFIDENCE=0.80, not calibration.
